title: Patellar Tracking
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Ask them to extend the knee slowly, and watch the patella from directly in front rather than from the side.
Repeat with the patient actively flexing from full extension, since a deviation appearing on the way out and on the way back in is more convincing than one seen once.
Compare with the other knee, and note the knee's alignment and the foot position, since both change the track.
